original.statement: Traefik Pilot static configuration (e.g. pilot.token) is no longer supported in v3 and prevents Traefik from starting; it must be removed from the static configuration.

decision.reason: [ev-9f3bf592e4e8] shows that Pilot was configured through the `pilot` section of the static configuration (`pilot.token` in YAML/TOML, `--pilot.token` on the CLI). It also says this configuration "is now unsupported and would prevent Traefik to start", and that all of it must be removed. So the static-config key `pilot` no longer exists in v3, and config-key with path `pilot` and change type `removed` matches the evidence.
